target: More efficient, production PostgreSQL drop-in replacement; MySQL/TDS compatibility also requested

gates.requirement: Native PostgreSQL SQL, type/OID, catalog, protocol, transaction and tooling behavior; upstream regression and real application suites
Synchronous commit-before-ack; crash recovery; exclusive writer; failed-storage guards
PostgreSQL SCRAM implemented; role authorization and MySQL/TDS credentials missing
Native TLS and channel binding with authenticated transport tests
PostgreSQL-scale data/connections and default READ COMMITTED; bounded page storage/streamed results; concurrent write progress
Offline whole-WAL copy implemented; online backup, checkpointing, WAL compaction and upgrade migrations missing
Efficiency improvement with equivalent supported semantics, durability, storage and representative workloads
Monitoring, cancellation, roles, schema/data migration and tested operational recovery; full supported-platform release matrix

gates.evidence: tools/test_persistence.py tests process termination and injected I/O failures
gates.requirement: Power-loss and filesystem/device fault validation on supported deployment storage
